recipe.title: Chilli Con Carne

ingredients.name: Sour cream, yoghurt, grated cheese, coriander./cilantro

steps.text: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add garlic and onion, cook for 1 minute, then add capsicum and cook for 2 minutes until onion is translucent.
steps.label: Start

steps.text: Turn heat up to high and add beef. Cook, breaking it up as you go, until mostly browned.
steps.label: Brown beef

steps.text: Add Chili Spice Mix. Cook until beef is browned all over. (This step helps release extra flavour from the spices)
steps.label: Toast spices
steps.doneness_cue: until beef is browned all over

steps.text: Add remaining ingredients, with 1/2 cup of water for Quick Cook or 1 1/2 cups for Slow Cook. Bring to simmer, then adjust heat per step below:
steps.label: Combine ingredients

steps.text: Quick Cook - 20 to 40 minutes, uncovered, on medium low heat so it's bubbling gently;
steps.label: Quick cook

steps.text: Slow Cook - 1.5 hours to 2 hours, covered, on low heat so it's bubbling very gently.
steps.label: Slow cook
steps.attention_cue: covered, on low heat so it's bubbling very gently

steps.text: Adjust salt to taste just before serving.
steps.label: Season

steps.text: Serve over rice, or ladle into bowls and serve with corn chips or warm tortillas on the side with Toppings of choice. My usual: Either over rice or with corn chips, always with sour cream, cheese and coriander.
steps.label: Serve
consumes_ingredients: Sour cream, yoghurt, grated cheese, coriander./cilantro
